svg.title: DataTwin — plan view rotating into section view
svg.desc: DataTwin is drawn as one enclosed body. Outside it, fourteen source systems feed data inward. Inside it, six modules run through three shared engine stages. At its centre — and, once rotated, at its base — sits the ERP, outside the body, receiving only what passed.
svg.text: One engine, two views of the same object
DataTwin sits between the systems you already run and the ledger they feed. Everything cyan is DataTwin; everything outside it is yours.
